associations.rationale: The type constructs a representation on AlgIrrepGL, but does not state its irreducibility, highest-weight characterization, uniqueness, or the displayed Schur-module determinant-twist construction.
The type proves simplicity of the AlgIrrepGL representation, covering irreducibility but not the highest-weight existence, uniqueness, and explicit construction in the source claim.
The type says two members of the AlgIrrepGL family are isomorphic exactly when their dominant weights agree, which supports uniqueness but does not state the full existence and construction claim.
The type proves simplicity of a Schur module for an antitone natural-valued weight; it is a prerequisite for the construction, not the entire integer-weight classification and determinant twist.
